Jamie: Heads up — partner audit flagged a few PII lines in prod logs. Need a 1hr console sudo to remove sensitive fields and run a redaction script. Env=prod, service=log-processor. Can someone grant break-glass for jamie and sam? @Tara @Leo
AuditBot: New audit ticket created: AUD-4521. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/AUD-4521
Leo: @Jamie ok — need exact scope. console sudo on which project/role? Confirm start/end times and that you'll record the session.
Jamie: Scope: console sudo on `prod-console` for `jamie` and `sam` only. Time window requested 14:30-15:30 UTC. Planned command: ```kubectl logs -n infra log-processor-7 | jq 'del(.user_email)' > redacted.log && gsutil cp redacted.log gs://redacted-audit/```
Tara: I'm on pager — conditions for approval: 1) Attach AUD-4521 ticket to the request 2) session recording enabled and stored in audit bucket 3) disable screenshots and external sharing for the window. Also provide a short justification in the JIT request. If those are met I can approve.
Jamie: Added AUD-4521 to the request and disabled screenshot sharing per policy. Justification: remove exposed partner PII before audit recert. Will notify sec-oncall before starting. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Just-in-time elev request logged: request id jitre-871. Audit trail and session recording scheduled.
Leo: Granting break-glass: console-sudo for jamie,sam from 2960008200 to 2960011800 (1h). Request id jitre-871. Please notify sec-oncall at start. :lock:
Jamie: Acknowledged. Starting now and pinging @Tara. Running redaction script — ETA ~20m.
Tara: Watching the window. If anything unexpected happens, stop and call me immediately. :eyes:
AuditBot: Session recorded to s3://audit-sessions/jitre-871/session-2960007890.mp4
Jamie: Redaction complete. Uploaded to gs://redacted-audit/AUD-4521/redacted.log. I dropped sudo and closed the session.
Leo: Confirmed no active elevated sessions for jitre-871. Closing the just-in-time request. Thanks everyone.
